title: Remaining Contract Share and the Remobilization Fee — Professional Services Projects
content:
The share of a Professional Services Projects contract still to be billed scales the remobilization fee of a fixed-fee engagement resumed after a long client-caused hold.

**Rule.** Where the remaining share is the contract value, which every signed change order has moved by its value change, less everything billed by the deposit and milestone invoices, as a percent of the contract value, the remobilization fee is scaled by 1.25 for a remaining share of 60 percent or more, by 1.1 for 25 percent or more but below 60 percent, and not at all for any smaller share.

| Remaining share | Scaling |
|---|---|
| 60 percent or more | 1.25 |
| 25 percent or more, below 60 percent | 1.1 |
| below 25 percent | none |

**Worked cases (hypothetical figures).** Contract value 80000.00 with 30000.00 billed by deposit and milestone invoices: 50000.00 remains, a share of 62.5 percent, scaled by 1.25. With 62000.00 billed, 18000.00 remains, a share of 22.5 percent, not scaled.
